column1: # Function-pointer structure members. layouts.tsv records such a member as `fn(...) *` (offset and size only);
# this table spells its type, `@` standing for the member's name. A row's type and member are layouts.tsv's. A
# member with no row here is declared `void (*m) (void)`: the table lists the members whose signature a standard,
# man page or the GNU C Library manual gives. A declarator `GNU-DECL ;; OTHER-DECL` is emitted as GNU-DECL under
# `#ifdef __USE_GNU` and OTHER-DECL otherwise; the tags GNU-DECL names are declared incomplete by the header's template.
# Sources: the GNU C Library manual (Argp Help Filtering, More Flags for Globbing).
